{{Quote|Will you, ah, require anything special for dinner?|The cook to Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''cook''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that served aboard the ''[[Concussor]]'', a [[Burst Fire-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel|''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel]] that [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, seized from the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The cook had no other hair except a long ponytail, and sported numerous scars and [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]. He could also understood [[Gamorrese|Gammorean]].<ref name="MK" />

One of the Wraiths, [[Voort saBinring]], thought that the cook made a fine [[Bantha-topato stew]].<ref name="MK" />
